verdict.rationale: Mixpanel's first-party Funnels report documents measuring conversion through a series of events, and its marketing says it helps teams find critical drop-off points, so the multi-step funnel core is clearly present. Filtering is documented only as a general property capability, and breakdowns appear only in the Query API, not specifically within funnels. missing for 10: explicit documentation of filters and breakdowns inside funnel reports, step-level drop-off visualization detail, independent hands-on corroboration of funnel building.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can build multi-step funnels with filters and breakdowns to find where users drop off

citations.quote: Measure conversions through a series of events
Discover critical drop-off points and calibrate user journeys
